scope: Latest recovered runs of the three original experiments. Additional faults and combinations remain in experiment history.

insights.title: Evaluate automated process health monitoring
insights.hypothesis: If automated monitoring detects paused processes, then the system can trigger alerts or auto-unpause to reduce MTTR.
insights.verification: Verify that alerts trigger when a container enters a paused state.

insights.title: Evaluate automated restart policy
insights.hypothesis: If the orchestrator is configured with an appropriate restart policy, then the service will recover automatically from unexpected shutdowns.
insights.verification: Verify orchestrator configuration for restart-on-failure policies.

insights.title: Evaluate automated network anomaly detection
insights.hypothesis: If automated alerts for high-latency network policies are implemented, then response time to injected impairments will decrease.
insights.verification: Monitor alert triggers during future network-related experiments.

insights.title: Evaluate shutdown signal handling
insights.hypothesis: Whether the service is receiving unexpected SIGTERM signals, then investigating the source of the shutdown signal will prevent future outages.
insights.verification: Review system and application logs for external signals triggering the shutdown hook.
